g.text: Two-Level Paging & TLB Hardware Translation Pipeline
Complete 32-bit Virtual Address to Physical Address translation sequence with Demand Paging
[ 10 bits Page Directory | 10 bits Page Table | 12 bits Page Offset (4 KiB) ]
Hit: Skip page table walks entirely!
Step 5: Physical Address Assembly & Effective Access Time (EAT)
• TLB Miss: 10 ns + 2×100 ns (PTs) + 100 ns = 310 ns
• Page Fault: 310 ns + 8,000,000 ns (Disk I/O) = 8,000,310 ns
